Behavior-inert bookkeeping inconsistency in a bundled, unrelated change.

The issue-2061 changeset states 'The reader and the internal docs were reconciled to match,' but the diff touches no code reader (e.g. scripts/workpad.py). Verified against HEAD by the truthfulness sweep: workpad.py --note already nests notes under ## Progress, so the reader DOES match at HEAD and the statement is not demonstrably false (a changeset legitimately describes release-spanning work). Left as filed at Suggestion; the phrasing is at most slightly overstated, not a documented_falsehood promoted to the self-contradicting-diff carve-out.

## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (Clean, complete mechanism deletion; two behavior-inert Suggestion-level notes on a bundled unrelated changeset)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #2065: Remove the stall-observer workflow, its scan helper, and its two config keys — criteria from issue-body; scope not-established (no workpad compared under head_override=local blinded shadow). Requirement-based checklist items are included in the verification results below. All six acceptance criteria verified mechanically against the tree:
- AC1: `git ls-files` lists neither `.github/workflows/stall-observer.yml` nor `scripts/stall-observer-scan.py` — only `.changeset/issue-2065-remove-stall-observer.md` matches the basename. PASS.
- AC2: a tree search for `stall-observer`/`stall_observer` returns matches in exactly the four allowed places (`CHANGELOG.md`, `.prflow/logs/pin-corpus-inventory.tsv`, `lib/test/coverage-map-retention-allow.json`, `.changeset/`); the config blocks, the three `lib/test/run.sh` literals, the `coverage-map.json` and `brand-devflow-buckets.json` entries, both test blocks, and the six doc locations are all gone. PASS.
- AC3: `lib/test/coverage-map-retention-allow.json` carries an entry with `half: files`, `key: scripts/stall-observer-scan.py`, non-empty `reason`. PASS.
- AC4: required CI checks (`lib + python tests`, `lint (shellcheck + actionlint + ruff)`) — not executed in this read-only shadow; all mechanically-coupled test literals (the #582 partition, both #1402 never-shipped-set expectations, brand-buckets, coverage-map, and the two Python test blocks) move consistently with the deletions, so the coupled suite detectors are expected green (external confirmation owed at merge).
- AC5: no replacement observer, workflow, scheduled job, or workpad-staleness scanner added. PASS.
- AC6: `.changeset/issue-2065-remove-stall-observer.md` present and accurate against HEAD (`stall_backstop` untouched; never shipped to consumers). PASS.

6 passed, 0 failed, 0 inconclusive — 6 via lite probe, 0 via agent. (AC-derived checklist; AC4/CI is the sole item awaiting external confirmation and is not a FAIL.)
